title: add-tenant-scoped-sidecar-templating-and-airgap-prepull-values-overlay
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in air-gapped or multi-tenant VPC environments asked for a safe, tenant-scoped way to inject optional init sidecars and to pre-pull images on cluster nodes without changing the core chart shape. This PR introduces a small templating DSL and values overlay to enable: 1) conditional tenant-scoped sidecar init jobs that run once per tenant namespace (useful for network probes, KMS attestation, or local credential seeding); 2) an optional cluster-level pre-pull DaemonSet for airgap image warmup that can be toggled per-environment; 3) an explicit, machine-validated values.schema.json extension so helm lint / IDEs can validate tenant overlays. Changes are implemented conservatively to avoid behavior changes when the new values are unset. Checklist: - [x] add templating helpers and tests - [x] provide airgap values example and README notes - [x] update values.schema.json with new keys and descriptions - [x] add unit tests for template rendering and a smoke helm template run - [x] confirm CI passes and address lint warnings Related: Linear ENG-4729 (tenant bootstrap hooks), SUP-8421 (support case requesting pre-pull for airgap installs). Notes on rollout: this is backwards-compatible; default booleans are off. For Dedicated/Hosted customers nothing changes unless the new knobs are explicitly set. See README for operator guidance and safe upgrade notes: charts/private/README.md.
commits: feat(helm): introduce templating helpers for tenant-scoped sidecar and namespace-guard
feat(helm): add optional airgap pre-pull DaemonSet and image-warmup hook
chore(schema): extend values.schema.json with tenantOverlay and airgapPrepull sections
test(helm): add helm template unit tests for tenant overlay scenarios
docs: document new values and upgrade guidance in charts/private/README.md
changed_files_summary: charts/private/values.schema.json — add tenantOverlay and airgapPrepull objects with descriptions and defaults
charts/private/values.airgap.example.yaml — example overlay for offline registries and pre-pull config
charts/private/templates/_helpers.tpl — new helper tpl: redwood.tenantHasOverlay, redwood.includeIfEnabled
charts/private/templates/sidecar-init-job.yaml — job template that renders per-namespace when tenantOverlay.initSidecar.enabled=true
charts/private/templates/prepull-daemonset.yaml — optional DaemonSet that runs pre-pull init containers and respects imagePullSecrets
charts/private/README.md — added operator notes, safe-upgrade steps and migration dry-run guidance
charts/private/tests/helm_template_test.yaml — new test cases for enabled/disabled combinations
review_conversation: Diego Ramirez (requested changes): The namespace-guard logic looks good but we should ensure the template doesn't create RBAC objects unless explicitly enabled. Could you gate RBAC creation behind tenantOverlay.createRBAC?
Maya Chen (reply): Good catch. I added tenantOverlay.createRBAC=false by default and wrapped the RBAC templates in the same helper. See commit 'feat(helm): gate RBAC for tenant overlays'
Priya Singh (comment): Please add a short note in README about the effect of enabling pre-pull in clusters with low disk space. Suggested text added in follow-up commit.

Luca Moretti (approved): Verified helm template outputs for both enabled and disabled cases. Unit tests cover the following: tenant overlay enabled, sidecar job rendered once per namespace, and airgap DaemonSet templated with imagePullSecrets. CI green.
Maya Chen (merge): Addressed all comments and fixed lint warnings; squashed commits for merge.
release_notes: Added tenantOverlay and airgapPrepull values to private chart. Operators can now enable tenant-scoped init sidecars and an optional pre-pull DaemonSet to warm images for air-gapped installs. Backwards-compatible; defaults off. See charts/private/README.md for upgrade notes and example overlays.
